تقليل القراءة الدورية أثناء اتصال Realtime مع قراءة احتياطية عند انقطاعه وتأخير المحاولات عند الأخطاء.
notesEn: Unifies notification delivery and read-state updates without displaying the same notification twice.
Reduces periodic reads while Realtime is connected, with REST fallback and retry backoff when unavailable.

limits: Dynamic names, external consumers and live traffic are not covered by literal reference matching.
A script being present or cached does not mean it executes Supabase requests.
Missing index script reference is not proof of unreachability; dynamic loading needs manual review.
SQL definitions in migrations do not establish actual Production migration order or active function bodies.
